sample_basis: Stratified sample of 81 of 199 title-deduplicated styles (395 feed listings = colourways; Petite cuts counted as separate styles); proportional by category, min 2 each. Percentages are of the 81 sampled; 2 sampled styles state no composition.
fab_basis: denim 14/199 styles in denim category (7%, census); cashmere 0 of 81 lead (1 style has 4% in blend); linen 2/81=2%; cotton 21/81=26%; wool 2/81=2% (alpaca 3/81 not counted as wool); synth lead (polyester, nylon, polyurethane) 28/81=35%; silk 7/81=9%; viscose/rayon 14/81=17% and modal 2/81 cellulosic, lyocell 0 lead
heritage_claim: Dated, not placed on site: 'founded in 2009' by Ruti Zisser; place only from press (garage, Palo Alto)
craft_reasoning: About and press pages state the 2009 founding and a designer-led story but no factory, maker, mill or process. Made-in was not read on product pages, so 1 is low-confidence and could rise to 2. Third-party yarn names appear (Superfine Alpaca, Terylence) without mills.
note: Listing links are parent categories from the nav (women's-only brand; all tiles women's): tops covers tees AND blouses plus sweaters; bottoms includes skirts; denim includes jackets/dresses/skirts; outerwear-and-vests includes blazers and cardigans; no jeans-only, tee-only or blouse-only page found; shoes not sold. Wrinkle-resistant/'washable silk' claims have no named tech cloth (proposed_tech 2). Shopify vendor field on a sampled product reads 'Guangyuetextile' (not shown to shoppers); recorded, not filed as a named maker. Elastane counted in spandex_styles at any share; 'spandex_high' not requested here.
